description: This script processes binary files by creating a header with specified addresses and prepends it to the input file. It uses struct packing for headers and allows command-line configurable parameters for addresses and filenames.

methods.name: auto_int(x)
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer, interpreting the base automatically.

methods.name: create_header(args, size)
methods.description: Creates a binary header containing entry address, load address, and size.

methods.name: create_output(args)
methods.description: Reads the input file, prepends a generated header, and writes the result to the output file.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Sets up command-line argument parsing and orchestrates the file processing.
